prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified. TWO rows TWO columns. TOP BOH adult male RETURNED craftsman, proposed thirty-something dark close-cropped hair, short beard, broad plain grey-blue tunic with patched brown work vest, trousers and worn boots, CLOSED small travel bundle held low, self-possessed restrained posture. No visible war wounds, weapons, armor or hero insignia, no invented battle history. BOTTOM REHA his older father, silver hair and beard, faded ochre wool cap held in one hand, plain brown wool coat over moss-green tunic, ordinary boots, thoughtful guarded posture. Two separate men with separate front/back views; no reunion, public speech, reconciliation, or mandatory new job. BOH is NOT NISHA missing brother; never draw the missing brother.
